TestCase.name: testBatchNestedAsyncPythonFunctionWithAnotherAsyncPythonFunction
TestCase.Resource: SELECT asyncFunc2(asyncFunc1(a, b), c), asyncFunc1(a + 1, b) FROM MyTable

Calc(select=[f0 AS EXPR$0, f1 AS EXPR$1]) +- PythonAsyncCalc(select=[f1, asyncFunc2(f0, c) AS f0]) +- PythonAsyncCalc(select=[c, f00 AS f0, asyncFunc1(f0, b) AS f1]) +- PythonAsyncCalc(select=[c, f0, b, asyncFunc1(a, b) AS f00]) +- Calc(select=[a, b, c, (a + 1) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testBatchRepeatedNestedPythonFunctionsWithLiteral
TestCase.Resource: SELECT pyFunc1(asyncFunc1(a, b), c), pyFunc1(asyncFunc1(a, b), c), 42 FROM MyTable

Calc(select=[f0 AS EXPR$0, f1 AS EXPR$1, 42 AS EXPR$2]) +- Calc(select=[f0, f0 AS f1]) +- PythonCalc(select=[pyFunc1(f0, c) AS f0]) +- PythonAsyncCalc(select=[c, asyncFunc1(a, b) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])
